student_learning_goal: I can identify congruent faces, lengths, and angles.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can identify congruent faces, lengths, and angles.
header.character_watermark: Compass Coco the Cat in the top-right with a compass and treasure map. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw lines from each shape on the left to its CONGRUENT match on the right.
parts.visual_layout: Two columns of 5 shapes each with line-drawing space between them for matching.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 congruent match layout for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. Left column: 5 shapes (small square, big triangle, small circle, oval, hexagon). Right column: 5 shapes scrambled with 5 congruent partners.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_MATCH at Part 1: keywords name the shapes match task in two columns.

parts.answer_key: Each left shape connected to its same-size same-shape match.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 shape pairs, circle YES if congruent, NO if not.
parts.visual_layout: Four shape pair boxes each with a YES and NO option to circle.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 yes-or-no decision layout for congruent worksheet, B&W line art. 4 pair boxes: same-size squares, different-size triangles, square+rectangle, congruent hexagons. Each pair: YES / NO circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_YN at Part 2: keywords name the pairs decision boxes with yes-or-no choices.

parts.student_instructions: Pick ONE pair you said was NOT congruent. Write WHY.
parts.visual_layout: Sentence frame with a fill-in for the pair number and an explanation block.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 explanation layout for congruent worksheet. Sentence frame: 'Pair ___ is NOT congruent because ___.' Below: 4 lines for student to explain.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_WHY at Part 3: keywords name the explain-the-pair writing task.

parts.answer_key: Any valid reason linking shape or size difference.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find ONE congruent pair in your classroom (e.g., two windows).
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Formative — check both-criteria reasoning.
